problems: bourbon-kingdom-of-france (Cliopatria 'Bourbon Kingdom of France', 1815..1847, 8 shapes) shares Wikidata Q207162 with this row. The Kingdom of France page's infobox carries the restorations of 1814-1848 inside the same state, but the First Republic, Consulate and Empire (1792-1814) intervene, so the rows were not merged: kingdom-of-france ends 21 Sept 1792 with french-first-republic as successor. If the orchestrator rules them one state, the merge belongs in a found event of the bourbon-kingdom-of-france dossier naming kingdom-of-france as predecessor.
The 801-year row was not split: Capetian, Valois and Bourbon are dynasties of one state (rename events 1328, 1589, 1791 per rule 2).

Counterparts that are descriptive strings and not slugs (the validator accepts them, a counterpart check will not): County of Sens, Gatinais, Moret-sur-Loing, Viscounty of Bourges, County of Chartres, County of Ponthieu, Limousin, 'Artois (holder not named by the page)' (1191; county-of-artois exists as a seed and should replace it), 'Alfonso, Count of Poitou (apanage)' (1271; county-of-toulouse and county-of-poitou are the matching dossiers), 'Allies (the page names no state)' (1708 loss of Lille), 'Hesse', 'German lands', and three confidence-1 shape additions (1402, 1407, 1640) that name only the land.

The Cliopatria France shape contains land the pages assign to other states (Navarre 1285-1332, Brittany 1492-1531, Bearn from 1595, Naples to 1506, Catalonia 1642-1652, Duchy of Lorraine from 1700, Toulouse/Poitou from 1250, colonies in 1791) and a stray cell in central Africa in 1220; these were cut or turned into vassal/occupation spans in the keyframe corrections. Neighbour dossiers should check their own overlaps with the France shape.
